item.title: THE SITUATIONAL: Thank You, Next
item.description: Michigan has scored on 13 of 18 2nd half drives since the rivalry turned, giving Matt Patricia the opportunity to force a 4th quarter punt for the first time since Jeff Hafley was Ohio State's defensive coordinator.

item.title: Ryan Day Radio Show: Ryan Day Says Ohio State-Michigan is “About Us and Our Execution,” the Buckeyes Have Been “Locked In” and Focused on Doing Their Job in Ann Arbor
item.description: Ryan Day says Ohio State-Michigan is "about us and our execution" and that the Buckeyes have been "locked in" and focused on doing their job in Ann Arbor.

item.title: Hot Off the Press: Football Game Poster for No. 1 Ohio State at That Team Up North
item.description: War! The force is strong with Ohio State this week as it prepares to face an Evil Empire that parades its maize and blue colors across the galaxy.

item.title: Mic Check: Ryan Day Focused On All Aspects Of The Game Ahead of Ohio State's Trip To Michigan
item.description: Running the ball and stopping the run have been calling cards in The Game for decades but executing in other facets are just as important to beating Michigan on Saturday.

item.title: Jeremiah Smith Says He’s “Good to Go” for The Game, Talks Michigan Hatred and Julian Sayin on "Downs 2 Business"
item.description: On Downs 2 Business, Jeremiah Smith confirms he’ll play vs. Michigan, talks rivalry hate, praises Julian Sayin, and shares his OSU WR Mount Rushmore.

item.title: Nick Saban Can’t Believe Many Ohio State Fans Would Rather Beat Michigan Than Win a National Championship: “Ohio State Fans Are Psychotic About This”
item.description: Coaching legend Nick Saban called Ohio State fans “psychotic” and can't believe many would rather beat Michigan than win a national championship. “They all need to go see a doctor.”

item.title: Louisiana Defensive Lineman Darryus McKinley Flips Commitment from LSU to Ohio State
item.description: Louisiana three-star defensive tackle Darryus McKinley flips his commitment from LSU to Ohio State, becoming the sixth defensive lineman in Ohio State’s 2026 recruiting class.

item.title: Lightning Round: Ryan Day Says “Everybody Was Out There” at Practice on Wednesday, Will Monitor Carnell Tate, Jeremiah Smith and Lorenzo Styles Jr.’s Health Over the Next 48 Hours
item.description: Ryan Day said "everybody was out there" at practice Wednesday and said Ohio State will monitor Carnell Tate, Jeremiah Smith and Lorenzo Styles Jr.'s health over the next 48 hours.

item.title: Press Coverage: Predictions for the Ohio State vs. Michigan Game As Buckeyes Look for Fast Start, Keep Emphasis on Routine
item.description: Following Ohio State’s final interviews of rivalry week, we react to what we heard from Ryan Day and players and make our predictions for how The Game will play out.

item.title: Quick Hits: Sonny Styles Says Cold Weather “Shouldn’t Really Impact The Game At All”, Caleb Downs Wants to Win “Every Snap” at Michigan
item.description: Austin Siereveld loves the chance to play in cold weather for The Game, while Sonny Styles says the weather “shouldn’t really impact the game at all.”
